name: Sega Saturn
significance: Showcased master-class 2D performance and groundbreaking arcade 3D conversions, though its dual-CPU architecture proved notoriously difficult for third parties to program.

verifiedFactualData.cpu: Dual Hitachi SH-2 32-bit RISC @ 28.6 MHz (8 processors total)
verifiedFactualData.ram: 2 MB work RAM, 1.5 MB VRAM, 512 KB audio RAM

editorialContent.overview: Sega's complex dual-CPU architecture that achieved 2D sprite perfection and arcade-quality 3D ports.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Showcased master-class 2D performance and groundbreaking arcade 3D conversions, though its dual-CPU architecture proved notoriously difficult for third parties to program.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Six-button digital control pad, 3D analog pad (1996)
